title: Union Pacific train strikes car near Old Santa Maria Road; investigation underway
excerpt: A Union Pacific train struck the rear of a car near Old Santa Maria Road and Markley Lane in West Laredo on Tuesday night. No train crew members were hurt, and the cause is under investigation.
content:
A Union Pacific train collided with the rear of a car near Old Santa Maria Road and Markley Lane in West Laredo on Tuesday night, according to KGNS.

The crash happened at around 8 p.m. Tuesday near 5320 Old Santa Maria Road, KGNS reported. No members of the train crew were hurt.

What happened to the people in the car is not yet clear from the official accounts. Laredo police told KGNS that two women in the car were in stable condition, while the Laredo Fire Department said Wednesday that no one was inside the car when it was hit. The two accounts differ as reported, and KGNS did not say which account is correct.

The cause of the collision is under investigation. The area around Old Santa Maria Road and Markley Lane was expected to be closed for several hours while crews worked at the scene, according to KGNS.

Sources: KGNS, Nov. 11, 2026; kgns.tv.
